name: Bishop's Stortford Autumn - British Blind Off 2022

venue.name: Birchwood High School
venue.address: Parsonage Lane, Bishop's Stortford, Hertfordshire, CM23 5BD

information: **PLEASE NOTE:** This is a Blindfolded specialist competition. We do not recommend this competition to first time competitors. Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. We will be holding 6x6 and 7x7 in addition, but we still regard this as a blindfolded specialist competition. The winner of 3x3 Multiple-Blindfolded will be announced as the winner of the competition. This is your final chance in the UK to qualify for [Kewbz UK Championship 2022](http://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/KewbzUKChampionship2022) for any blindfolded events, or 6x6 and 7x7!
